name: easycite
description: Verifiable citation recommendations for LaTeX writing.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Virtual Workspaces are not supported with EasyCite.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint

citation-agent.cwd.description: Sets the working directory for EasyCite. Supported variables: `${workspaceFolder}` (workspace root) and `${fileDirname}` (directory of the current file).

citation-agent.args.description: Arguments passed to the EasyCite Python backend. Each argument is a separate item in the array.

citation-agent.path.description: Reserved for a future external EasyCite executable. V2 normally uses the bundled Python backend.

citation-agent.importStrategy.description: Defines where EasyCite imports bundled Python libraries from. This setting may be ignored if `citation-agent.path` is set.
enumDescriptions: Use Python libraries from the selected environment, falling back to bundled libraries only if unavailable.

citation-agent.interpreter.description: When set to a path to python executable, extension will use that to launch the server and any subprocess.

citation-agent.showNotifications.description: Controls when notifications are shown by this extension.
enumDescriptions: All notifications are turned off, any errors or warning are still available in the logs.
Notifications are shown only in the case of an error.
Notifications are shown for errors and warnings.
Notifications are show for anything that the server chooses to show.

citation-agent.dependencyInstallMode.description: Controls whether EasyCite installs missing Python runtime packages into the extension private storage directory.
enumDescriptions: Ask before installing missing Python packages.
Install missing Python packages automatically into extension private storage.
Never install packages automatically; only report missing dependencies.

citation-agent.useLLM.description: When enabled, EasyCite V2 uses LiteLLM for citation-need detection. If disabled or unavailable, it falls back to local heuristic rules.

citation-agent.provider.description: Model provider label used for EasyCite configuration and logging.

citation-agent.model.description: LiteLLM model name for citation-need detection.

citation-agent.apiBase.description: Optional API base URL for OpenAI-compatible or private model gateways. API keys are stored in VS Code SecretStorage, not in settings.

citation-agent.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for lightweight LLM calls such as citation-need detection and retrieval query planning.

citation-agent.evidenceTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for each external LLM evidence-judging call. When it times out, EasyCite falls back to local rules for that candidate.

citation-agent.evidenceMaxLLMCandidates.description: Maximum number of shortlisted candidates judged by the external LLM during one audit. Set this to maxAbstractCandidates to judge every shortlisted candidate.

citation-agent.contextQueryBudgetTokens.description: Estimated input-token budget for LLM retrieval query planning. Required claim fields are retained; paragraph context and local query hints may be compacted.

citation-agent.contextEvidenceBudgetToke.description: Estimated input-token budget for each LLM evidence-verification request. Candidate identifiers remain intact while long passage text may be compacted.

citation-agent.contextTranslationBudgetT.description: Estimated input-token budget for each bilingual evidence translation request.

citation-agent.agentRuntime.description: Backend recommendation orchestrator. V10 uses a real LangGraph StateGraph by default; classic keeps the pre-v9 linear orchestrator as a fallback.
enumDescriptions: Run the citation recommendation workflow through a LangGraph StateGraph.
Use the pre-v9 in-process linear orchestrator.

citation-agent.maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of citation candidates returned from local BibTeX and Zotero sources.

citation-agent.maxMetadataCandidates.description: Maximum number of metadata candidates recalled before evidence verification.

citation-agent.maxAbstractCandidates.description: Maximum number of candidates sent to abstract/PDF evidence verification.

citation-agent.maxEvidencePassages.description: Maximum number of abstract/PDF passages read per candidate during evidence verification.

citation-agent.enableEvidenceVerificatio.description: When enabled, EasyCite ranks candidates by retrieved abstract/PDF evidence instead of metadata alone.

citation-agent.ragEnabled.description: Use the persistent local RAG pipeline for corpus sync, paper retrieval, passage retrieval and reranking. If unavailable, EasyCite reports the fallback and uses legacy metadata retrieval.

citation-agent.ragIndexPath.description: Optional path for the SQLite/FTS5 RAG index. Empty stores it under .citation-agent/rag.sqlite3 in the workspace.

citation-agent.ragMaxDocuments.description: Maximum citable papers synchronized from the selected Zotero Collection and current project bibliography.

citation-agent.ragChildChunkTokens.description: Target token size of child chunks used for precise passage retrieval.

citation-agent.ragChildChunkMaxTokens.description: Maximum token size of a child RAG chunk.

citation-agent.ragChunkOverlapTokens.description: Sentence-aware overlap between adjacent child chunks.

citation-agent.ragParentChunkTokens.description: Hard token ceiling for semantic parent chunks retained as evidence context.

citation-agent.ragSemanticChunkingEnable.description: Split PDF parents at paragraph-level semantic topic boundaries using the configured local embedding model.

citation-agent.ragSemanticBoundaryThresh.description: Soft paragraph boundary threshold after the minimum parent size is reached. Higher values create more semantic parents.

citation-agent.ragSemanticHardBoundaryTh.description: Hard paragraph boundary threshold applied even to short parents when adjacent topics are strongly different.

citation-agent.ragSemanticMinParentToken.description: Minimum parent size before a soft semantic boundary may split the text.

citation-agent.ragSemanticAdaptiveEnable.description: Detect relative topic changes from local similarity valleys when absolute similarities remain high.

citation-agent.ragSemanticAdaptivePercen.description: Section-local similarity percentile used as the adaptive semantic boundary threshold.

citation-agent.ragSemanticAdaptiveMaxThr.description: Upper bound for the adaptive semantic boundary threshold.

citation-agent.ragSemanticMinScoreDrop.description: Minimum local similarity drop required before an adaptive topic boundary is accepted.

citation-agent.ragSemanticContextWindow.description: Number of paragraphs compared on each side of a possible semantic boundary.

citation-agent.ragSemanticEmbeddingMinTo.description: Short PDF layout fragments below this size share a semantic embedding with adjacent prose while remaining intact in searchable text.

citation-agent.ragEmbeddingBatchSize.description: Paragraph embedding batch size used while incrementally indexing PDFs.

citation-agent.ragPaperFusedTopK.description: Number of papers retained after paper-level BM25/Dense reciprocal-rank fusion.

citation-agent.ragPassageFusedTopK.description: Number of passages retained after passage-level BM25/Dense reciprocal-rank fusion.

citation-agent.ragPdfIndexTopK.description: Maximum paper-level finalists whose Zotero PDF attachments are resolved and incrementally indexed in one foreground query.

citation-agent.ragRerankerEnabled.description: Rerank fused evidence passages with a local Cross-Encoder when its model is available.

citation-agent.ragRerankerModelId.description: FastEmbed Cross-Encoder model used for passage reranking.

citation-agent.ragRerankerInputK.description: Maximum fused passages passed to the local reranker.

citation-agent.ragRerankerTopK.description: Maximum passages retained after reranking and before per-paper diversity selection.

citation-agent.embeddingEnabled.description: Enable V3 local semantic passage ranking. When disabled or unavailable, EasyCite falls back to deterministic lexical evidence ranking.

citation-agent.embeddingModelProvider.description: Provider for the local embedding model. V3 currently supports fastembed for CPU ONNX inference; 'hash' is reserved for deterministic development tests.

citation-agent.embeddingModelId.description: Model identifier for local semantic passage retrieval.

citation-agent.embeddingCacheDir.description: Optional local cache directory for downloaded embedding models. Empty means EasyCite uses ~/.cache/citation-agent/embeddings.

citation-agent.embeddingAutoDownload.description: Controls first-run embedding model download behavior.

citation-agent.embeddingTopK.description: Number of hybrid-ranked passages retained before truncating to maxEvidencePassages for LLM judgment.

citation-agent.hybridLexicalWeight.description: Lexical score weight used by V3 hybrid evidence passage ranking.

citation-agent.hybridEmbeddingWeight.description: Embedding similarity weight used by V3 hybrid evidence passage ranking.

citation-agent.scanUseEmbedding.description: Use the local embedding model to semantically refine background citation-needed scan diagnostics. Requires embeddingEnabled and a running EasyCite backend; otherwise lexical scan is used.

citation-agent.scanEmbeddingThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity to citation-needed prototype claims for keeping an automatically scanned yellow diagnostic.

citation-agent.scanMaxSentences.description: Maximum number of lexical citation-scan candidate sentences sent to the embedding model per scanned TeX file.

citation-agent.zoteroEnabled.description: Enable the optional read-only Zotero HTTP adapter. Current BibTeX search works without Zotero.

citation-agent.zoteroEndpoint.description: Optional local Zotero-compatible HTTP endpoint. V2 tries GET /search?q=... and /items?q=..., expecting JSON items with title and optional citationKey/pdfPath.

citation-agent.zoteroAutoOpenWithoutProm.description: When enabled, EasyCite automatically launches Zotero if the configured local Zotero API is unavailable.

citation-agent.zoteroLaunchCommand.description: Optional custom command used to launch Zotero. Empty means EasyCite uses a platform default that prefers minimized/background startup when possible.

citation-agent.zoteroCollectionKeys.description: Optional Zotero collection keys used to limit candidate search. Empty means EasyCite searches the whole local Zotero library.

citation-agent.debugTargetPapers.description: Optional target papers to trace through every citation recommendation stage. Add a title fragment, citation key, DOI, or Zotero-searchable phrase to diagnose why a known paper was not recommended.

citation-agent.memoryEnabled.description: Use project-local feedback memory to softly boost accepted papers and demote rejected papers for similar future citation claims.

citation-agent.memoryPath.description: Optional custom SQLite path for EasyCite feedback memory. Empty stores memory under the workspace .citation-agent directory.

citation-agent.memoryPositiveBoost.description: Maximum confidence boost applied to previously accepted papers for similar claims.

citation-agent.memoryNegativePenalty.description: Maximum confidence penalty applied to previously rejected papers for similar claims.

citation-agent.memoryMinSimilarity.description: Minimum token-overlap similarity between the current claim and prior feedback before feedback memory affects ranking.

citation-agent.developerMode.description: Show developer-only debugging and eval tools, including Bad Case export in the candidate review panel. Keep disabled for normal writing workflows.
